judged_text: The fetch to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT has no timeout (and no response.ok check) and sits on the token-refresh path of every calendar/video operation in sharing mode. A slow or hung sync endpoint stalls booking create/update requests until undici's default ~300s headers/body timeout with no cap or failure signal, and an endpoint 500 is only surfaced later as a generic 'Invalid refreshed tokens were returned' that misdescribes the failure.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when sharing mode is enabled it calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams(...) })` with no AbortSignal/timeout and no `response.ok` / status handling, then returns the raw `Response`. This sits directly on the token-refresh path for multiple integrations (e.g., Google/Office365/Zoom/Webex services now call `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`), so a slow/hung sync endpoint can stall those operations, and non-2xx responses are not explicitly handled at this layer.
